summary: Frontend visual redesign (dark anthracite + red #e63946 accent) verified end-to-end. Desktop 1920 and Mobile 390 tested across / /menu /hakkimizda /galeri /iletisim /admin. Hero split layout, Cormorant Garamond serif heading, red eyebrow + red 'Menüyü İncele' CTA (bg=rgb(230,57,70), text=white), circular kumpir dish (hero-dish testid) all render correctly. No horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth=390 on all mobile pages). Menu shows 33 items with zero price elements and no ₺ symbol. Hamburger, sticky bottom bar (Menü/Ara/Yol Tarifi), WhatsApp FAB, language switcher (TR/DE toggle), reservation hidden (as expected) — all working. No uncaught runtime errors, no error-boundary overlay.
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): React warns 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.js line 98 the uses lowercase `fetchpriority`. Change to `fetchPriority` (camelCase) to silence the console warning. Purely cosmetic.
MINOR: Two 401 responses seen in console (likely /api/admin/* probes on landing) — expected for unauthenticated visitor but consider guarding those calls.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js still references legacy `text-gold` / `!border-gold/30` classes (Instagram icon, campaign cards) — visually they render RED now because --gold CSS variable was flipped, which works but is semantically confusing. Consider a mass-rename to `text-accent` in a future cleanup pass.
MenuItemCard.js line 14 uses invalid Tailwind class `font-800` alongside `font-bold` — no-op but should be cleaned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign iteration 12 fully passes. Only a React DOM prop warning (fetchpriority → fetchPriority) and a leftover font-800 class remain — both non-visual/non-functional. All prior iterations (1-11) preserved functionality; content, routes, features unchanged; prices/cart still absent; reservation still hidden. Screenshots verified: hero serif title 'EFSANE LEZZET / SİZLERLE.', red CTA, circular kumpir dish on right (desktop) and stacked below (mobile) with no horizontal scroll.
